decision.explanation: The question asks for sports teams represented by Sergio González Soriano. Source D1 explicitly states he played for Guizhou Renhe F.C., Atlético Madrid (youth/first team context), Real Valladolid, and Racing de Santander. Source D2 describes his long-term association with RCD Espanyol de Barcelona, noting he joined their youth academy, rose to the first team, served as captain, and is synonymous with the club. All five teams listed in the original R5 answers are directly supported by the text as entities he represented. Proposals for specific roles (captain, midfielder) or locations (youth academy, stadium) are excluded as they describe attributes or places rather than the team entity itself. The nicknames (Periquitos) and competitions (Chinese FA Cup, UEFA Cup) are also excluded as they are not team names.
